subject: LangChain Bridge & Safety Trace: NebulaStack collab kickoff
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@nebulastack.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in LangChain bridge + safety tracing

Hi Karthik —

Hope you’re well. Quick intro: NebulaStack builds a managed data mesh for LLM apps and we’ve started prototyping a LangChain bridge that preserves prompt-level telemetry and safety signals across runtimes. We’d love to explore a collaboration with Redwood to: 1) wire tracing into Redwood’s serving runtime so prompts and KV cache events surface in our telemetry, and 2) integrate a lightweight safety/safeguard hook that can run prompt-level checks before generation.

We believe this could be a strong ISV integration: co-marketing + a joint sandbox for ISVs who want end-to-end observability. Attached a short proposal with architecture sketches.

Would you be open to a tech sync this week? Our team: Marco (CTO) and our integrations/devs mailbox.

Thanks — looking forward,
Alice

--
Alice Wong
Head of Integrations, NebulaStack
alice.wong@nebulastack.com
attachment: nebulastack-proposal.pdf (pdf)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@nebulastack.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in LangChain bridge + safety tracing

Alice — thanks for reaching out and for the clear summary. This aligns well with several roadmap items (tracing hooks + safety gating). I’ve looped in Vanessa (partnerships) and Marissa (platform) to discuss telemetry contract and acceptance criteria.

Suggested next steps:
- 30–45m technical sync (langchain bridge + trace event schema)
- Short mutual action plan listing milestones (sandbox, PR, validation tests, co-demo)
- List of minimal acceptance criteria for safety/safeguard and what falls under partner vs Redwood scope

Can your team do 03/03 10:00am PT? If not, propose two times and we’ll pick. I attached a quick internal template (MVP scope) that we can use to align.

Karthik
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
attachment: mvp-scope.xlsx (xlsx)
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@nebulastack.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in LangChain bridge + safety tracing

Appreciate the intro, Alice. From a GTM/commercial perspective we’ll want to surface: SOW options (sandbox + pilot + co-sell), basic pricing for dedicated support, and a proposed timeline for a joint sandbox. I’d like the technical sync to cover what we’ll need for an enterprise sandbox (VPC peering, test data controls, telemetry retention).

Please have Marco or your integrations PM share any security/compliance constraints up front (SOC2 requirements, data residency) so we can flag early.

Thanks — Vanessa
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@nebulastack.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marco.silva@nebulastack.com, devops@nebulastack.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in LangChain bridge + safety tracing

Thanks, Vanessa and Karthik. 03/03 10:00am PT works for Marco and me. Sharing a repo and a short runbook before the sync: https://github.com/nebulastack/langchain-bridge — includes a small sandbox image and our initial trace schema (open to aligning to Redwood conventions). We don’t have SOC2 publicly yet but can share our vendor questionnaire and a compliance snapshot in the sync.

See you tomorrow.

Best,
Alice
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: alice.wong@nebulastack.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Notes: NebulaStack sync 03/03 — action items + tracing spec

On Wed, Mar 3, 2027 at 10:00 AM NebulaStack <> Redwood sync:
- Attendees: Alice (NebulaStack), Marco (NebulaStack), Karthik, Vanessa, Marissa, Soojin
- Key decisions: agree to prototype a LangChain "bridge" that emits trace events for: prompt_input, kv_cache_hit/miss, model_selection, response_tokens. NebulaStack will add a safety hook API (pre_generate check) that Redwood runtime can call synchronously.
- Action items (owners):
  * NebulaStack: open sandbox repo invite + PR with sample trace events (by 03/05) — Alice/Marco
  * Redwood (Marissa): create an acceptance test harness for trace ingestion and safety hook validation (by 03/12)
  * Karthik/Vanessa: draft MSA addendum and sandbox SOW for pilot (first pass by 03/08)

I’m attaching a trace spec draft we reviewed in the call (tracing-spec-v1.md) and a short checklist. Please review and comment inline on the GitHub repo.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Product Manager, Platform | Redwood Inference
attachment: tracing-spec-v1.md (md)

On Wed, Mar 3, 2027 at 10:00 AM, Alice Wong wrote:
> Looking forward to the PR — we’ll include a demo sequence and sample telemetry.
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Next steps: prioritize NebulaStack LangChain bridge in Q2 backlog

Team — quick summary/final ask after the sync and Marissa’s notes:
- The NebulaStack integration is lightweight from a runtime perspective but high-impact for ISV GTM and observability coverage. The safety hook is minimal and can be feature-flagged.
- Please greenlight two engineers and one SRE for a 6-week spike (prototype + acceptance harness). Estimated effort: 2 FTEs for 6 weeks, SRE support for 2 weeks.
- Vanessa, can you draft the sandbox SOW and a basic pilot pricing tier I can use to start discussions with Revenue?
- Marissa, please scope the acceptance tests and confirm if we need any infra spend for sandbox traffic.

If everyone agrees, I’ll submit a quick PR to the Q2 backlog and tag this as priority:medium. Need thumbs by end of day Monday.

Thanks — Karthik
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
